about: A network laid out by force from a seed: nodes are discs as large as their weight, and a focus lights what a node connects to within a number of hops.

controlled.about: The caller keeps the focus in its own state through focus and onFocusChange, so a list, a search result or the address can focus a department. A press on a disc or the Clear focus control reports the new focus back.
controlled.label: Referrals between departments
controlled.title: Controlled focus

empty.about: A network without a node renders its message in the canvas's place, at the canvas's ratio, without the controls, the readout or the overview.
empty.label: Claims handled jointly
empty.message: No claim was handled by more than one adjuster this month.
empty.title: Empty

mentoring.about: depth={2} lights the people two hops away as well. Elena mentors three people, and at two hops six of the other seven are lit: past one hop a dense network lights nearly everything.
mentoring.label: Mentoring network
mentoring.prompt: Select a person to see who they are connected to.
mentoring.summary_one: {{count}} person is within two hops of {{name}}.
mentoring.summary_other: {{count}} people are within two hops of {{name}}.
mentoring.title: Two hops

modules.about: No module states a weight, so each disc is as large as the number of modules taken beside it: Statistics I is taken with all five others and is the largest.
modules.label: Modules taken together
modules.prompt: Select a module to see what is taken beside it.
modules.title: Sized by links

pinned.about: draggable={false} pins every site where the layout put it, for a diagram that goes into a report. Panning, zooming and the focus still work, and the description offers no arrow key.
pinned.label: Inbound supply network
pinned.prompt: Select a site to see what it depends on.
pinned.title: Pinned

rail.about: Forty stations and eighty services, laid out from seed 6. The shape reads at a glance and the names read once you zoom in, where the overview map shows which part of the network is in view.
rail.label: Intercity rail network
rail.prompt: Select a station to see where it has direct services.
rail.title: Forty stations

title: Network graph

topology.about: The graph opens focused on checkout-api: the services it calls are lit, the rest recede, and the readout counts them. A disc is as large as its weight and a line as wide as its tie. Drag a disc, or move the focused one with the arrow keys, to rearrange the picture.
topology.caption: Checkout writes to Kafka and Postgres, which the ledger reads, and nothing calls the fax gateway.
topology.label: Service topology
topology.prompt: Select a service to light up what it talks to.
topology.title: Service topology

words.description: Press Enter or Space to focus the node, the arrow keys to move it, and Escape to clear the focus.
words.fixed: Press Enter or Space to focus the node, and Escape to clear the focus.
